test-rotate-wait.pddl:
(define (problem test-rotate-wait)
    (:domain MultiRobotRunner)
    (:objects
        a b - robot
        p1 p2 p3 - gridsquare
        north east - direction
        c0 c1 c2 - counter
    )
    (:init
        (robot-at a p1)
        (robot-at b p3)
        (robot-rotated a north)
        (robot-rotated b north)
        (rotation-adjacent north east)
        (gridsquare-connected p1 p2 east)
        (choosing)
        (unplanned a)
        (unplanned b)
        (remaining c2)
        (next-count c0 c1)
        (next-count c1 c2)
        (zero c0)
        (robot-count c2)
    )
    (:goal (and
        (choosing)
        (robot-at a p2)
        (robot-at b p3)
    ))
)

test-cycle.pddl:
(define (problem test-cycle)
    (:domain MultiRobotRunner)
    (:objects
        a b c - robot
        p1 p2 p3 - gridsquare
        d1 d2 d3 - direction
        c0 c1 c2 c3 - counter
    )
    (:init
        (robot-at a p1)
        (robot-at b p2)
        (robot-at c p3)
        (robot-rotated a d1)
        (robot-rotated b d2)
        (robot-rotated c d3)
        (gridsquare-connected p1 p2 d1)
        (gridsquare-connected p2 p3 d2)
        (gridsquare-connected p3 p1 d3)
        (choosing)
        (unplanned a)
        (unplanned b)
        (unplanned c)
        (remaining c3)
        (next-count c0 c1)
        (next-count c1 c2)
        (next-count c2 c3)
        (zero c0)
        (robot-count c3)
    )
    (:goal (and
        (choosing)
        (robot-at a p2)
        (robot-at b p3)
        (robot-at c p1)
    ))
)
